items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember Andy Smith used to talk about him... Did you know Pike? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Pike Davis. Yeah, I used see Pike all the time.

ctx.x: Joe Smith... Well, I didn't know him either. I saw him once. He went to Kansas City with the Cotton-Pickers, McKinney's Cotton Pickers, and he met a woman out there and he stayed out there for six months. Some big sportin' woman. 'Cause he was a cat could mesmerize you with that trumpet. Joe Smith, yeah.
Yeah. He was in Kelly's Hot Chocolates and those shows. I remember Andy Smith used to talk about him, and another guy named Pike Davis. Did you know Pike?

Yeah, Pike Davis. Yeah, I used see Pike all the time. Pike Davis was a trumpet player who was a rival of Johnny Dunn. He used to be the first trumpet player in the branch of them Broadway shows. They know how to play with that dead tone. They don't use no vibrato in those shows, in that pit.
